metadata.description: Marketplace for the 3A8 estimation factory plugin.

plugins.name: 3a8
plugins.description: 3A8 (TriAngulEight): Software estimation instrument for Claude Code: three chained sensors build a product model, cross it with a declared technology and size it by counting; a reference-class sensor runs blind to them; a gap-blind rate round and a diagnosis explain the divergence instead of averaging it. Numbers come from a pinned rate table; the model only chooses rows.
